steps.text: Each card is an energy community open to the public, with its regulator. Click a card to learn more.
steps.title: The public communities directory

steps.text: Expanding a community reveals its description, website, registered office and, above all, the list of its public sharing operations.
steps.title: Expand a community

steps.text: The "Test Community" offers several public sharing operations (solar, wind). Each operation lists the municipalities it covers.
steps.title: The sharing operations

steps.text: Type a municipality and pick it from the suggestions to keep only the communities active there. You can also filter by regulator.
steps.title: Filter by municipality

steps.text: "Test Community" runs a sharing operation in Anderlecht, so it stays listed. A municipality with no active community would show an empty directory.
steps.title: Filtered result
